interpretation_limits: Same-capture byte comparisons validate declared exported rows only; raw Q/V/A differences are descriptive and have no new acceptance threshold.
ON cold preparation includes recorded byte-check observer time. Observer seconds are a measured subset, not a separate wall-time saving; warm attribute timing excludes new bank capture.
Cold OFF/ON captures are distinct native forwards; numerical variation between captures is not silently attributed to storage selection.
Per-rank walls run in parallel and are not summed as whole job wall time.
Artifact storage bytes do not explain all PSS/cgroup memory or prove a leak.
Rank completion alone does not prove driver exit, deployment,32k capacity or improved training effectiveness.
